package.name: inspire_hand_bridge
package.description:
Plain ROS 2 <-> DDS bridge for the Inspire Hand RH56DFTP (motor control + tactile skin). Translates the existing production DDS topics (rt/inspire_hand/{ctrl,state,touch}/{l,r}, served by the Modbus-to-DDS driver in inspire_hand_ws/inspire_hand_sdk) to: - a sensor_msgs/JointState command topic (target position in radians, by joint name) -> a single DDS ctrl write per message (no trajectory controller; the hand firmware generates the motion); - a full sensor_msgs/JointState /joint_states topic (actuated + mimic + wrist) for robot_state_publisher / TF / RViz; - 17 per-region tactile topics (sensor_msgs/Image, mono16), one per region of rh56dftp_description/tactile/tactile_layout.yaml. No ros2_control. The bridge never talks Modbus itself: the DDS driver stays the single writer to the hardware (no concurrent command path).
Extra Python dependencies without a rosdep key (see README): cyclonedds==0.10.2 and inspire_sdkpy (the DDS type definitions), which must be importable by the Python running ROS 2 (Python 3.12 for Jazzy).
